_why: Which pages the gates actually check. A gate that passes because it is not looking is worse than no gate, so the scope is written down here rather than implied. A page joins this list when it has been converted to public/css/synos.css and the partial markers, and it may never leave.
_phase: Phase 1 converted about.html. Phase 3 converted index.html. Figures in /figures/ are always in render-gate scope.
